defs.def: serious and very important; affecting the most central and important parts of sth 十分重大的；根本的

ex.s: Such wrinkles will no doubt be ironed out, yet they also point to a fundamental problem.
ex.t: 这些缺陷无疑会被解决，但它们也指向一个根本问题。

ex.s: Success ___36___ fundamentally on our view of ourselves and of the ____37____ in our lives.
ex.t: 成功___36___根本上取决于我们对自己的看法以及对我们生活中____37____的看法。

ex.s: Genome editing, serving as a new weapon in the fight against diseases, will lead to a fundamental change in our approach to health care.
ex.t: 基因组编辑作为对抗疾病的新武器，将从根本上改变我们的医疗保健方式。

defs.def: central; forming the necessary basis of sth 基础的；基本的

ex.s: Yet as Martin has found in her work, gender is one of the fundamental ways people form connections with objects, particularly those designed with human characteristics.
ex.t: 然而正如马丁在工作中发现的，性别是人们与物品建立联系的基本方式之一

ex.s: The field of artificial life-called ALife for short — is the systematic attempt to spell out life’s fundamental principles.
ex.t: 人工生命领域——简称ALife——是系统性地阐明生命基本原理的尝试。

ex.s: Color is fundamental in home design — something you’ll always have in every room.
ex.t: 色彩是家居设计的基础——这是你在每个房间都会拥有的东西。

ex.s: But he is also working at a far more fundamental level: his staff show people how to make floating gardens and fish ponds prevent starvation during the wet season.
ex.t: 但他也在更基础的层面上工作：他的工作人员教人们如何建造浮动花园和鱼塘以防止雨季发生饥荒。

ex.s: The fundamental purpose of Silkroad is to bring people from across the globe together to play and listen to music.
ex.t: 丝绸之路的基本目的是将全球各地的人们聚集在一起演奏和聆听音乐。

ex.s: Finally, a fundamental key to healthy eating is to eat slowly.
ex.t: 最后，健康饮食的一个基本关键是慢慢吃。

ex.s: Detail(s): DA fundamental key to healthy eating is to eat slowly.
ex.t: 细节：健康饮食的一个基本关键是慢慢吃。

ex.s: The advertising industry started with the fundamental purpose of agencies would create a basictype of advertisement known as a commercial advertisement.
ex.t: 广告业开始的基本目的是广告公司将创建一种被称为商业广告的基本广告类型。

defs.def: forming the source or base from which everything else is made; not able to be divided any further 基本的；不能再分的
